Name: Verstave - Expedition 33 new NPC mod
Author: Erevendi229
Description:
[img]https://stardewvalleywiki.com/mediawiki/images/5/57/Junimo.gif[/img]﻿

Gustave, Verso and Esquie move into the valley!   

''After Gustave's lab in ZuZu city blows up and he is loses his arm. Verso, his husband, knows they need a quieter live to Pelican town - quieter it is, except for their menace of a cat Esquie."

[img]https://stardewvalleywiki.com/mediawiki/images/2/25/Battery_Pack.png[/img] Content [img]https://stardewvalleywiki.com/mediawiki/images/2/25/Battery_Pack.png[/img]

* Gustave opens a store where you can buy machines 
* New groweable crop; Lumina. Grow and ship it with your shipping bin and Gustave will reward you!
* 3 fully dialogued, schedules NPCs 
* 2/3/4/6/8 heart events for Gustave and Verso
* 2/4/6/8 heart events for Esquie
* Plenty of quests (Esquie will drive you nuts)
* They appear in Festivals!!! (when Esquie can be bothered!)
* Custom map for their house and shop 


[img]https://stardewvalleywiki.com/mediawiki/images/2/2f/Blue_Jazz.png[/img]
